profile.name: Tango设备连接器
profile.description: 一个用于实验控制软件的非物理组件，用来依据 Tango 资源定位符连接 Tango 设备服务器，并按类型注解自动创建子设备或信号。它支持真实连接与模拟连接，适合将基于 Tango Controls 的实验仪器统一接入异步控制流程。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for laboratory control systems that connects to Tango device servers using a Tango resource locator and can automatically create child devices or signals from annotations. It supports both real and mock connections, helping integrate Tango Controls-based instruments into an asynchronous experiment workflow.

registry.name: Tango Controls Tango Device Connector
registry.description: Tango Device Connector是由Tango Controls (ESRF)生产的后处理设备，主要功能包括设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, create children from annotations等操作。
